gap.$description: Distance between the control and the supporting row.

typescale.$description: The supporting text and the error text.

gap.$description: The least room between the end of the label and its requirement mark and the start of the value text; below it the value text moves to a line of its own.

typescale.$description: The value in words at the end of the label row: the label's text style, so that the two share one baseline and read as one line.

gap.$description: While separation is gap: the space the attachment keeps from the stage above it and from the frame's inline and bottom edges, in place of the line. In the plain look, the space between the stage and the attachment.

color.$description: The caption's color: secondary content. It is drawn outside the frame, on the surface the figure sits on, where this role is held against every surface.

gap.$description: Between the frame and the caption below it; in the plain look also between the title and the stage.

typescale.$description: The caption: secondary text, one body role below the interface's, the style prose gives its small print. A caption is a sentence, so it is a body style and not a label's.

shape.$description: The frame's corners, and in the plain look the stage's own: the step of a card and of a callout, so a figure reads as one of the page's blocks. What is shown is clipped to them.

color.$description: The color the outlined and the filled looks hand to what is in the stage, as the platform's inherited foreground: the content color of both fills. The plain look hands nothing: its content takes the color of the surface the figure sits on.

The line between the header and the stage and between the stage and the attachment, while separation is divider: the one hairline. It keeps its own token so that a system can draw it apart from the frame's edge.
The fill of the filled look: a quiet step of the surface ladder, which sets the stage apart by tone and draws no edge.

gap.$description: Between the title and the actions, between two actions, and between the title and a row of actions that moved below it.

padding-block.$description: Above and below the header's row.

padding-inline.$description: Before the title, and after it where there are no actions.

padding-inline-end-with-actions.$description: After the actions: tighter than after text, because a control's own shape already holds its content away from the edge. The callout makes the same distinction for its close button.

color.$description: The edge of the outlined look: the one hairline, the color a divider and an outlined card draw theirs in. Decorative. It keeps its own token so that a system can draw this edge apart from its dividers.

width.$description: The width of the outlined look's edge, drawn inside the frame's size.

color.$description: The fill of the outlined look, inside the one hairline: the surface itself, the fill an outlined card has. A stage is a known surface, so that what is shown on it has the contrast its own tokens were held to.
The plain look has no fill: the surface the figure sits on shows through, and what is shown is its own frame.

separation.$description: How the parts inside the frame — the header, the stage, the attachment — are told apart. divider: a line of divider.thickness in divider.color between them, the attachment flush with the frame. gap: no line; the attachment stands attachment.gap inside the frame with its own shape. Follows the system's choice; a figure's separation prop overrides it (FIG-12). The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values; platforms receive the name.

padding-block.$description: Above and below what is shown, while the figure is inset and has a frame: room enough that a specimen's focus ring, shadow and state layer are not cut by the frame, and that a small specimen does not look pressed between two lines.

padding-inline.$description: Before and after what is shown, while the figure is inset and has a frame.

typescale.$description: The title: the interface's text size at the heading's weight, the style a callout's title has. It is the label of what is shown, never a heading by itself.

gap.$description: The least space between the two actions. Where the minimum target in force exceeds action.size by more than half of it, they stand twice that excess apart, so that each hit area reaches the minimum target on its own half of the space between them (FIT-18).

size.$description: An action's glyph, and the mark of a link that opens a new context.

shape.$description: The corners of an action's container and state layer: a circle in the default system, as an icon-only button.

size.$description: The side of an action's square container (retry, remove): its container height. Its hit area meets the minimum target.

color.$description: The mark of a file that is done: the success role, used for that status alone. The status is also said in words.
The mark of a file that failed: the error role.
The error text of a file that failed, in place of its status: the error role, used for errors and nothing else.
The file's name: the surface's text color.

typescale.$description: The file's name: a list row's headline.

color.$description: The glyph of the file's format, whatever the format: secondary content. A format has no color of its own.
The ground of a tile's box and of a row's picture box: seen behind a format glyph, around a picture that is fitted whole, and until a picture is drawn.

cycle-duration.$description: One cycle of the bar while how far it has come is unknown, and one pulse of its reduced-motion form: the progress indicator's.

cycle-easing.$description: How the segment and the pulse move through a cycle.

feedback-duration.$description: How long the answer to a press takes to spread when sys.behavior.pressed-feedback is ripple (as Button's). Unused by the other choices.

progress-duration.$description: How long the bar takes to reach a new value: the progress indicator's.

state-duration.$description: How long a change of the colors of the body or of an action takes between states.

gap.$description: The space between a row's texts and its progress bar.

color.$description: The part of the bar that is done: primary, as a progress indicator's.

shape.$description: The ends of the bar's track and indicator in a row, clamped to half the thickness. In a tile the bar is clipped by the box's corners.

thickness.$description: The height of the progress bar: its container height, the small linear progress indicator's.

color.$description: The bar's track: the low-emphasis fill tracks have. Opaque, so the bar is read over a picture.
A row action's fill at rest: none.
The glyph of the row's remove and retry actions: secondary content, as a quiet icon-only button's.
The color hover, focus and press mix into an action of the row: its glyph's color.
The ground of the row's body at rest: none. Hover, focus and a press mix the state layer into it, over the glyph or the picture, while the body is pressable.

gap.$description: The space between a row's glyph or picture, its texts and its actions.

outset.$description: How far the state layer of a pressable row's body reaches beyond its glyph and texts on every side. It takes no room: the row is laid out as a row that cannot be pressed.

shape.$description: The corners of the state layer and of the focus ring of a pressable row's body.

size.$description: The glyph of the file's format before a row's texts: a list row's leading glyph.

height.$description: The side of the square a row draws its picture in while preview is true, and its glyph centred in while there is no picture: its container height, a list row's leading picture.

shape.$description: The corners of a row's picture.

color.$description: The color hover, focus and press mix into the body of a pressable row: the color of the file's name.

gap.$description: The space between that mark and the words it stands before.

size.$description: The mark before the words of a file that is done or failed, on the second line.

color.$description: The format, the size and the status: secondary content.

typescale.$description: The second line — the format, the size and the status, or the error: a list row's supporting text.

color.$description: The disc under a tile's action: the lowest surface, opaque, so that the glyph is read over any picture.
The glyph of the tile's remove and retry actions: secondary content, as a quiet icon-only button's.

inset.$description: How far a tile's actions stand from the top and the end edge of its box.

color.$description: The color hover, focus and press mix into an action of the tile: its glyph's color.
The ground of the tile's body at rest: none. Hover, focus and a press mix the state layer into it, over the glyph or the picture, while the body is pressable.

gap.$description: The space between a tile's box and the texts beneath it.

shape.$description: The corners of a tile's box, of the picture clipped to it, and of the body's state layer and focus ring: a card's.

size.$description: The glyph of the file's format in the middle of a tile that draws no picture.

height.$description: The height of a tile's box where the product gives none, and its width where the product gives none: its container height. A tile is a square unless the product says otherwise.

color.$description: The color hover, focus and press mix into the body of a pressable tile: the color of the file's name.

gap.$description: The space between the area's parts: its glyph, its prompt, the trigger and the line of limits.

padding-block.$description: The room above the area's first part and below its last: what makes the area a place large enough to aim a dragged file at.

padding-inline.$description: The room at the area's start and end: the inset a card and a callout give their content.

shape.$description: The drop area's corners: the step a card, a callout and a figure have, so the area reads as one of the form's blocks.

size.$description: The glyph at the top of the area: the largest step of the icon scale, as an empty state's.

typescale.$description: The area's prompt (dropText): the interface's running text.

feedback-duration.$description: How long the answer to a press takes to spread when sys.behavior.pressed-feedback is ripple (as Button's). Unused by the other choices.

state-duration.$description: How long a change of the area's colors takes between states and conditions.

dash-length.$description: The length of one dash and of the gap after it while outline.style is dashed, measured along the edge. Unused while it is solid.

style.$description: How the area's edge is drawn. dashed: dashes and gaps of outline.dash-length, the mark of a place something can be put. solid: one unbroken line. The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values; platforms receive the name.

width.$description: The width of the area's edge, drawn inside the area's size, in every condition.

color.$description: The area's fill while it will take what is dragged over it: the quiet selection, because the area is the place now chosen.
The glyph, the prompt and the line of limits on that fill: its own content color.
The edge on that fill.
The glyph, which becomes the icon set's block glyph, in the same role.
The edge while the area will not take what is dragged over it: the error role, because letting go here fails.

typescale.$description: The text beside the trigger that says what is chosen now (selectionText): running text, on the trigger's line.

color.$description: The area's fill at rest: none.
The area's edge under the error condition: the error role. The words of the error are the Field's.
The area's glyph: secondary content, decorative.
The area's prompt: the surface's text color.
The area's edge: the boundary a person must see to find a control, as an outlined field's.
The text beside the trigger: secondary content, quieter than a file's name in a list.
The color hover and press mix into the area: its prompt's color.
The line of limits, in both layouts: secondary content.

gap.$description: In the button layout, the space between the trigger's row and the line of limits below it.

typescale.$description: The line that states the limits (constraintsText): the smallest size of text that is read, because it is read before choosing.

gap.$description: In the button layout, the space between the trigger and the text beside it.
The space between the file picker (the area, or the trigger and its line of limits) and the first file.

variant.$description: The Button variant of the bar's controls — zoom out, zoom in and close — icon-only medium Buttons (IMP-8). The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values, the core Button variants; platforms receive the name.

color.$description: The fill of the bar, over a zoomed picture that passes under it.

gap.$description: Between two controls of the bar. With the Buttons' own targets (BTN-5) it keeps each whole target apart from the next in the default system.

height.$description: The least height of the bar at the top; it grows where the count wraps. The picture at fit ends below it (IMP-11).

padding-inline.$description: Between the bar's first and last control and the window's safe area at each side.

color.$description: The caption's color: here the caption is the text of the view, not small print under a frame.
The fill behind the caption, over a zoomed picture that passes under it.

max-width.$description: The widest the caption's column draws, centred in the window; its lines begin at the column's start.

padding-block.$description: Above and below the caption's text.

padding-inline.$description: Before and after the caption's text, inside the window's safe area.

typescale.$description: The caption: a sentence about the picture, read at the interface's reading size.

color.$description: The surface that fills the window behind the picture, and what shows through a picture's transparent parts. The theme's own surface in the light and in the dark theme: the preview is a view of the product like any other, not a room of another color.
The count: secondary to the picture and to the controls.

padding-inline.$description: Before and after the count, so that its text begins where the caption's padding begins.

typescale.$description: The count's text style: a short line of interface text, as a label is.

gap.$description: Between the mark and the sentence.

color.$description: The mark's color: a quiet statement, not the error status — nothing the person did failed and nothing is theirs to correct.

size.$description: The mark of a picture that did not arrive.

color.$description: The sentence's color, as the mark's.

typescale.$description: The product's sentence under the mark.

page-gap.$description: Between the picture that leaves and the one that arrives while one replaces the other, so that two pictures with the same edge color do not read as one.

controls-duration.$description: The fade of the bar, the previous and next controls and the caption when they are hidden or shown.

enter-scale.$description: The size the picture grows from, as a fraction of its size at fit, while the preview fades in. 1 fades without growing.

page-duration.$description: The move to another picture by a button or a key, and the settle of a released drag.

zoom-duration.$description: A zoom step by a button, a key or a double tap, and the return to fit. A pinch follows the fingers and has no duration.

variant.$description: The Button variant of the previous and next controls, icon-only medium Buttons that stand over the picture's sides (IMP-10). The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values, the core Button variants; platforms receive the name.

margin-inline.$description: Between the previous or the next control and the window's safe area at its side.

color.$description: The fill behind the text in the tonal form: the faintest fill that still reads as a shape on the surfaces text sits on, the one a key cap takes. Decorative: the face tells code from words where the fill cannot be seen (on a container of the same tone, in forced colors). The plain form draws none.

padding-inline.$description: Room between the fill's edge and the text, at the start and the end of every piece of a run. It is drawn, not typed: copying the text copies no space for it.

shape.$description: The fill's corners, on every piece of a run that breaks across lines.

color.$description: The text's color in the tonal form, read on container.color. Inside a link the text takes the link's color in its place. The plain form takes the color of the text around it and reads no token.

scale.$description: How large the code face is drawn, as a fraction of the font size of the text it sits in: in body text it is the code role's own size, and in a heading, a lead paragraph or a caption it keeps the same proportion. 1 draws both faces at one size.

typescale.$description: The face: the family, weight and letter spacing of the code role. Its size and line height are not taken: the size is the surrounding text's by label.scale, and inline code never sets a line's height.

color.$description: The edge of the fill where a layer gives it a width: the system's one hairline. Decorative.

width.$description: The width of an edge around the fill, drawn inside it. Nothing in the default system: a fill or a line, not both. A layer that draws its inline code outlined sets it (sys.border.hairline).
The filled box's bottom line at rest; the focused width is a state token.

gap.$description: Distance between the prefix or suffix and the value: a currency sign sits tight against the amount, closer than an icon sits to text.

shape.$description: The corners of the container: all four of a stacked or an outlined box, the top two of a filled box.

shape-bottom.$description: The bottom corners of a filled box, along its active indicator. An outlined box rounds all four corners by container.shape.

color.$description: The asterisk of a required control: the color the required chip is filled with, not the error color, which is kept for errors.

label-duration.$description: How long the label takes to float or rest.

notch-padding.$description: The gap left in the outline on each side of a floated label.

width.$description: The outlined box's border at rest; the focused width is a state token.

color.$description: The asterisk of a required control: the color the required chip is filled with, not the error color, which is kept for errors.

asterisk-gap.$description: Distance between the floating label's text and the asterisk: it belongs to the word it follows.

color.$description: The highlight behind selected text and under the focused segment of a date or time, in every look and state. Without it each platform draws its own default. Selected text, and the segment that is being set, are the one that is chosen now, and the system marks that with a primary fill under on-primary content wherever it appears (the tabs' thumb, the calendar's selected day, the filled button, the required chip); the accent stays the focus ring's alone. Pair: selection.content.color.

The text on the highlight: selected text, and the number or the placeholder of the focused segment of a date or time. on-primary on primary, the pair that means the one that is chosen now; a layer whose highlight is a tint that keeps the value's color readable sets this to that color.
The label keeps naming the control; the inner line, the error text and the trailing icon show the error.
The asterisk of a required control: the color the required chip is filled with, not the error color, which is kept for errors.

A key cap's fill, in the keycap form (the plain form draws no cap): the faintest fill that still reads as a shape on the surfaces a shortcut sits on, since in the default system it is all there is of the cap. It stays at rest when the shortcut is disabled: the legend fades, the key does not.
The legends on the caps, and the separators between them: one step quieter than body text, because a shortcut is a hint beside the command, and still text held to 4.5:1 on the cap's fill.

bottom-width.$description: A key cap's bottom edge, drawn inside the cap's size. Nothing in the default system. Where a layer sets it thicker than outline.width it reads as the key's front face; a layer with flat outlined keys sets it to outline.width.

color.$description: A key cap's edge and its deeper bottom edge, in the keycap form, where a layer gives them a width; the default system's widths are 0, so it draws neither. Decorative: the legend carries the meaning, so the edge needs no contrast of its own. It stays at rest when the shortcut is disabled.

width.$description: A key cap's edge on its top and sides, drawn inside the cap's size. Nothing in the default system: a cap is a faint fill and no line. A layer that wants outlined keys sets it (sys.border.hairline).

color.$description: The shortcut drawn as text: quieter than the text beside it, because it is a hint about that text, not part of it.

padding.$description: The room between the card's edge and its text, on every side of the text. The picture has none: it reaches the card's edges.

shape.$description: The card's corners: the step a card, a figure and a callout have, so a link card reads as one of the page's blocks. The picture is clipped to them.

max-lines.$description: The most lines of the description that are drawn; a longer one ends with an ellipsis. All of it still reaches assistive technology.

typescale.$description: The description's text style: the interface's running text.

color.$description: The fill of the filled look: a tone of the surface ladder, which sets the card apart without an edge.
The color hover, focus and press mix into the container: the title's color.

beside-min-width.$description: The card's own inline size from which the picture stands beside the text; a narrower card draws it above. A width of the card, not of the window, and not a size of anything drawn. It grows with enlarged text, so a card whose text has doubled stacks sooner.

aspect-ratio.$description: The proportion, width to height, of the picture's box while it stands above the text and takes the card's whole width: the wide proportion pictures made to stand for a page are usually drawn in, so most are shown whole.

color.$description: The fill of the picture's box while the picture is loading, and behind its transparent parts: a quiet tone, so the box is seen and nothing moves when the picture arrives.

width.$description: The inline size of the picture's box while it stands beside the text; the box is as tall as the card. It does not grow with enlarged text: a picture is not read.

feedback-duration.$description: How long the answer to a press takes to spread when sys.behavior.pressed-feedback is ripple: the pressed layer grows from the point of contact over this time, with state-easing. Unused by the other choices.

width.$description: The width of the outlined look's edge, drawn inside the card's size and above the picture.

color.$description: The fill of the outlined look: the surface itself, inside the one hairline.
The description: secondary content, quieter than the title.
The edge of the outlined look: the one hairline, the color a divider and an outlined card draw theirs in.
The site line — the site's name, the host and the mark of a new context: secondary content. It keeps its own token so that a product can draw where a card leads at full strength.
The color hover, focus and press mix into the container: the title's color.
The title: the surface's text color, the one part of the card at full strength. Not the link color: the card's shape, not a color, says it is pressed as a whole.

gap.$description: The space between the site line and the text above it.

shape.$description: The corners the site icon is clipped to. A site's icon is a picture with its own outline; a small corner keeps a square one from looking cut out of the card.

size.$description: The side of the site icon's square box: the smallest step of the icon scale, beside one line of small text.

item-gap.$description: The space between the parts of the site line: the icon, the site's name, the host and the mark.

typescale.$description: The text style of the site line: the smallest size of text that is read, because the host is what tells a reader where the card leads.

gap.$description: The space between the title and the description.

max-lines.$description: The most lines of the title that are drawn; a longer title ends with an ellipsis. All of it still reaches assistive technology.

typescale.$description: The title's text style: the size of text that is read, at a heading's weight, so the title is told from the description by weight and not by a larger size. It is never exposed as a heading.

gap.$description: Space between a glyph and the text beside it.

shape.$description: The corners of the shape that carries hover, focus and press behind the link's text, on each line the link runs over, and of the focus ring around it.

marks.$description: What a link to another site shows beside its label. all: the picture of that site before the label, where the product gives one, and the arrow after it. arrow: the arrow alone. none: neither, and the link then says nothing of leaving the site. It does not touch the mark of a new context (LNK-13). One link is set apart by its external prop and by giving it no picture. The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values; platforms receive the name.

color.$description: The fill behind the link's text on each line it runs over. None at rest: it is where hover, focus and press are drawn.
The link that names the place the person is already at, in a set of navigation: the color of the text around it, because it is where they are and not somewhere to go.
The glyph of a link that has no text (a heading's anchor); beside text a glyph takes label.color. A glyph alone is a step quieter than a word, as an icon-only Button's is.

A link's text on a surface of the opposite theme (sys.color.inverse-surface), where the standard link color has no contrast to rely on: the role the vocabulary keeps for links there, so that a layer that recolors links recolors them on every surface.
The color hover, focus and press mix into the container: the link's own text color.

feedback-duration.$description: How long the answer to a press takes to spread when sys.behavior.pressed-feedback is ripple: the pressed layer grows from the point of contact over this time, with state-easing. Unused by the other choices.

disabled-opacity.$description: How much of the picture is left on a disabled link. A picture has no color to change, so it recedes with the label by opacity: the system's own for disabled content.

shape.$description: The corners of the picture of the site an external link leads to. The picture's box is as large as the font size of the link's text, as a glyph's is, and stands container.gap from the label.

color.$description: The fill behind the link's text on each line it runs over. None at rest: it is where hover, focus and press are drawn.
The link that names the place the person is already at, in a set of navigation: the color of the text around it, because it is where they are and not somewhere to go.
The glyph of a link that has no text (a heading's anchor); beside text a glyph takes label.color. A glyph alone is a step quieter than a word, as an icon-only Button's is.
A link's text on the product's ordinary surfaces and quiet containers: the role the vocabulary keeps for text links.
The color hover, focus and press mix into the container: the link's own text color.

offset.$description: How far below the text's baseline the underline is drawn.

visibility.$description: When the underline is drawn. always: at rest and in every state. hover: while the link is hovered, focused from the keyboard or pressed, and not at rest. never: in no state. Follows the system's choice; a link's underline prop overrides it (LNK-27). The current link and a glyph alone have no underline under any choice, and forced colors draw it under every choice (LNK-22). The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values; platforms receive the name.

width.$description: The underline's thickness. The underline takes the label's color in every state.

gap.$description: Space between an item's content and the parts the list draws beside it: the check of an option, the mark of a link that opens a new context, the handle of a reorderable item.

height.$description: The minimum height of an item that is an action, a link or an option. A minimum: the item grows with its content and with enlarged text.

padding-block.$description: Space above and below the content of such an item; it shows once the content is taller than the minimum height.

padding-inline-end.$description: Space between the content (or the check) of such an item and its end edge.

padding-inline-start.$description: Space between the start edge of an item that is an action, a link or an option and its content; it lines the content up with the page's.

shape.$description: The corners of an item that is an action, a link or an option, and of a dragged item. Square by default: items meet edge to edge.

typescale.$description: The text style an item that is an action, a link or an option hands its content: text the product did not style takes it.

color.$description: The fill of an item while it is dragged, under its content. Opaque, where a static item has no fill: the item is carried over the others and they must not show through it.

elevation.$description: The shadow of an item while it is dragged: it is above the list for as long as it is carried, and comes down when it is dropped.

size.$description: The glyph box of the check (the icon set's check) of a selected option, reserved in every option of a selectable list: a glyph's ink fills less of its box than a drawn path of that size.

width.$description: The stroke of the check drawn as a path. No behaviour of the current spec reads it: the check is a glyph of the icon set (LST-21). It stays only so that the platforms that still draw it as a path keep building; remove it in the commit that brings the last of them up to date.

feedback-duration.$description: How long the answer to a press takes to spread when sys.behavior.pressed-feedback is ripple (as Button's).

reorder-duration.$description: How long an item takes to change place: the items that slide aside under a dragged one, the dropped item settling, an item lifted by the keyboard stepping to its next place, and items changing places after a move (LST-38, LST-41). Longer than a change of color: something crosses the length of an item.

color.$description: The fill of a selected option, drawn over whatever the list stands on and under the item's content (LST-25). The role named here is the quiet selection's; the default system does not draw that tone — it values this token as a layer of the item's own content color (selected.state-layer.color at 16%, twice the hover layer: tokens/systems/tanrei.system.json), as the menu values its checked row, so that the fill is seen by the same step on whatever the surface is and stands apart from a hovered item. A design system that sets this token draws what it sets. The check is always drawn with the fill; the fill never carries the choice alone.
The color hover, focus and press mix into the item: its content's color.
The foreground an item that is an action, a link or an option hands its content: the color of text and glyphs the product did not color.
The color hover, focus and press mix into the item: its content's color.
The indicator on the surface behind it, when not contained.

cycle-duration.$description: One full turn of the arc, and one pulse of the reduced-motion form.

enter-duration.$description: The length of the entrance, fade or grow.

enter-easing.$description: The curve of the entrance: it arrives fast and settles, as an element entering the screen does.

entrance.$description: How the indicator enters once its show delay has passed. fade: the whole component eases its opacity from 0 to 1. grow: it fades the same way and grows from nothing to its full size about its center at the same time. Under reduced motion grow is drawn as fade. The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values; platforms receive the name.

show-delay.$description: How long the indicator waits, from the moment it is inserted, before it is drawn and exposed to assistive technology, so that a wait shorter than this shows nothing instead of a mark that flashes. Its box is kept during the wait.

color.$description: The label, and the icon beside it or alone (as Button's icon, it takes the label color, so collapsing does not recolor it).
The color hover, focus and press mix into the container. As Button's, it is the label color.

feedback-duration.$description: How long the answer to a press takes to spread when sys.behavior.pressed-feedback is ripple (as Button's).

resize-duration.$description: How long the container takes to collapse to its icon or extend to show its label.

color.$description: The label, and the icon beside it or alone (as Button's icon, it takes the label color, so collapsing does not recolor it).
The color hover, focus and press mix into the container. As Button's, it is the label color.
The label, and the icon beside it or alone (as Button's icon, it takes the label color, so collapsing does not recolor it).
The color hover, focus and press mix into the container. As Button's, it is the label color.

mark.$description: How a checkbox item is marked unless the item or its group names a glyph (markIcon). checkbox: the look of the checkbox, drawn in both conditions — an empty box, and a filled box with a check. check: the icon set's check while the item is checked, nothing while it is not. The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values; platforms receive the name.

height.$description: Minimum height of an item. It grows to the minimum target for touch, with its content and with enlarged text.

shape.$description: The corners of an item's row, which the state layer fills.
The corner of that box: the checkbox's own 2, one unit of the roundness dial.

size.$description: The side of the box of the checkbox look: the checkbox's own 18. It is centered in the mark column (mark.size).

inset.$description: How far the fill inside a checked ring sits from the ring's inner edge. 0 fills what the ring leaves; a larger inset turns the fill into a dot. The radio button's own value.

opacity.$description: The opacity the fill inside a checked ring is drawn at, applied to the control color of the condition and state. The radio button's own value; where the fill meets the ring it is held 3:1 against the ring on the menu's sheet, the checked row's fill under it (WCAG 1.4.11).

size.$description: The glyph box of the check drawn inside a checked box (the icon set's check), as the checkbox draws its own: a glyph's ink fills less of its box than the box it sits on.

weight.$description: The weight the check inside a checked box is drawn at (the `wght` axis of the icon font): the system's weight for a control's own mark, as the checkbox draws its own, so that a checkbox in a menu and one in a form agree (MNU-39). The glyph box (control.mark.size) does not change with it; only the stroke does. The check of the glyph look (mark.size, MNU-22) is an icon on the sheet and keeps sys.icon.weight.

width.$description: The border of an unchecked box, drawn inside its edge.

selected-width-share.$description: The stroke of a checked ring, as a share of the ring's radius, drawn inward from the outer diameter: 0 keeps ring.width, 1 is a solid disc. The radio button's own value.

size.$description: The outer diameter of the ring of the radio look, the same checked and unchecked: the radio button's own 20. It is centered in the mark column (mark.size).

width.$description: The stroke of an unchecked ring, drawn inside its outer diameter, and the thinnest a checked ring's stroke can be.

color.$description: The fill of the link item that names the page the person is on (MNU-58): it has no mark, so this fill tells it from its neighbours, in every contrast scheme. The default system values it as a layer of the row's own content color (current.state-layer.color at 16%, twice the hover layer: tokens/systems/tanrei.system.json); the menubar's current link item draws the same fill.
The color hover, focus and press mix into the item's row: the label's color.
On the fill every part of the content takes the fill's own content role, so that none of it loses contrast when the row is hovered or pressed.
The color hover, focus and press mix into the item's row: the label's color.

space.$description: Under divider: space above and below the divider between two groups. Not read under gap.

color.$description: The row of a submenu item while its submenu is open: a quiet fill that stays when the pointer and focus have moved into the submenu, so that the path to the surface in use stays marked (MNU-50). The default system does not draw this tone on the sheet — it values this token as the hover layer (expanded.state-layer.color at sys.state.hover-state-layer-opacity: tokens/systems/tanrei.system.json), so the open item keeps the look it had under the pointer, and it does not stack a second layer on it. A design system that sets this token draws what it sets.
The color hover, focus and press mix into the item's row: the label's color.
The submenu indicator of the item whose submenu is open.
A group's title: quieter than the items, which are what a person acts on.

padding-inline.$description: How far a group's title is inset from the rows' start and end edges. It follows the rows' own padding, so the title starts where the rows' content starts (the check, the leading icon or the label, whichever comes first), not after the check and icon columns.

gap.$description: Under gap: the empty space between a group and what is next to it, in place of the divider and its two spaces. Sixteen, so that the step between two groups is plainly larger than the step between two rows of one group (at the default height about 28 of clear space lies between two labels of one group, and 44 across the gap). Not read under divider.

size.$description: The width of the mark column, reserved in every item of a surface that has a checkbox or radio item, and the glyph box of a mark that is a glyph: the icon set's check, or the glyph markIcon names. A control look (control.box.size, control.ring.size) is centered in it. Medium, the size of the leading icon beside it.

width.$description: The stroke of the check drawn as a path. No behaviour of the current spec reads it: the check is a glyph of the icon set (MNU-22). It stays only so that the platforms that still draw it as a path keep building; remove it in the commit that brings the last of them up to date.

close-duration.$description: How long the sheet takes to fade out.

feedback-duration.$description: How long the answer to a press takes to spread when sys.behavior.pressed-feedback is ripple (as Button's).

open-duration.$description: How long the sheet takes to fade in and grow from the anchor's side.

submenu-delay.$description: How long a pointer rests on a submenu item before its submenu opens, and how long it may rest on the way to an open submenu before the item under it takes over (MNU-44, MNU-45). It reads the pointer's intent; it is not an animation and is not shortened where motion is reduced.

mark.$description: How a radio item is marked unless the item or its group names a glyph (markIcon). radio: the look of the radio button, drawn in both conditions — a thin ring, and a heavy ring with its fill. check: the icon set's check while the item is checked, nothing while it is not. The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values; platforms receive the name.

color.$description: The fill of a checked item's row, drawn over the menu's sheet (MNU-37). A checked item is told by its mark; this fill only supports it. The role named here is the quiet selection's; the default system does not draw that tone on the sheet — it values this token as a layer of the row's own content color (selected.state-layer.color), none at standard contrast and 16% at medium and high contrast (tokens/systems/tanrei.system.json), so that a person who asks for more contrast is given the fill as a second cue. A design system that sets this token draws what it sets.
The check drawn inside a checked box.
The control look of a checked item: the box's outline and fill, and the ring and its fill. The checkbox's and the radio button's selected color.
The mark when it is a glyph: the icon set's check, or the glyph markIcon names.
The color hover, focus and press mix into the item's row: the label's color.
On the fill every part of the content takes the fill's own content role, so that none of it loses contrast when the row is hovered or pressed.

separation.$description: How a group is told from what is next to it. divider: a line of divider.thickness in divider.color, with divider.space above and below it. gap: group.gap of empty space and no line. Follows the system's choice; a menu's separation prop overrides it (MNU-35), and a submenu follows its menu. The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values; platforms receive the name.

variant.$description: How a menu draws an item's keyboard shortcut: keycap draws each key in a cap, plain draws the shortcut as text. The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values, which are the keyboard shortcut's core variants; platforms receive the name.

offset.$description: Distance between the edge of the surface a submenu opens from and the submenu's surface, along the inline axis.

color.$description: The menu's sheet: white in light schemes, lifted above the page in dark ones.

offset.$description: Distance between the anchor and the sheet.

padding-inline.$description: Insets the items' rows from the sheet's sides, so a highlighted row shows its own corners.

viewport-margin.$description: The sheet stays at least this far inside the viewport's edges.

size.$description: The size of an item's trailing icon, and of the submenu indicator (the icon set's chevron_right) a submenu item draws in the same column.

color.$description: The line of a control look while the item is not checked: the border of the empty box and the thin ring. The functional outline role, as the checkbox's and the radio button's.
The color hover, focus and press mix into the item's row: the label's color.
The fill of the whole bar, behind every title and across its full width.

gap.$description: Distance between the visible bounds of two neighbouring titles. Their hit areas meet at the middle of it (MBR-17). It is small because the titles of one bar are read as one row of words, and not zero so that the open title's fill and a hovered neighbour's stay two shapes.

padding-block.$description: Space above and below the titles. With container.height it gives the bar's height: 4 + 40 + 4 = 48 in the default system, which is sys.target.touch, so that a title's touch target lies inside the bar.

padding-inline.$description: Space between the bar's start and end edges and its first and last titles.

gap.$description: Distance between an entry's label and the glyph after it: the mark open_in_new of a link item that opens a new context (MBR-37), and the indicator expand_more of a menu's title while the bar mixes menus with bar items (MBR-32). 4 in the default system, so that the word and its mark read as one entry: the mark stands much nearer its own word than the next entry's, which is two paddings and bar.gap away.

height.$description: Minimum height of a title's container: the medium Button's 40, because a title is pressed as a button is. It grows with enlarged text; the hit area extends to the minimum target.

padding-inline.$description: Space between a title's container edge and its label, on each side: 12, the inset of a menu's own rows (comp.menu.container.padding-inline), so that a title's label stands over the labels of the menu it opens once the menu's own inset is added.

shape.$description: The corners of a title's container, which the state layer and the open title's fill take: the step a menu's own row has, because a title is one choice among several in a row and not a button that stands alone.

color.$description: The title of the menu that is open: a quiet fill that stays while the pointer and focus are in the menu below it, so that the bar keeps saying which menu is shown (MBR-9). The default system does not draw this tone: it values this token as the hover layer (expanded.state-layer.color at sys.state.hover-state-layer-opacity, in tokens/systems/tanrei.system.json), as it does for the menu's own item whose submenu is open, because the bar has no fill of its own and a tone chosen against one surface may not show on another. A design system that sets this token draws what it sets.
The glyph of the overflow item (more_horiz), the one title that is a glyph and not a word: it takes the color a title's label has, so that it reads as one more title.
The color hover, focus and press mix into the title's container: the label's color.

size.$description: The glyph box of a glyph an entry draws: the overflow item's more_horiz, and the new-context mark open_in_new after a link item's label (MBR-37).

The glyph box of the indicator expand_more that a menu's title ends in while the bar mixes menus with bar items (MBR-32), container.gap after the label. One step smaller than icon.size, as a disclosure glyph beside a word is: it marks the title, it is not a second word.

typescale.$description: A title's text style: the style of a menu's own item labels, so that the bar and its menus read as one list in two directions.

feedback-duration.$description: How long the answer to a press takes to spread when sys.behavior.pressed-feedback is ripple (as Button's).

color.$description: The fill of the link item that names the page the person is on (MBR-38): the fill of the menu's current link item, so that the current place is drawn the same in the bar and in a menu. A design system that sets the menu's sets this one with it.
The new-context mark of a current link item, in the color of the menu's current row's glyphs.
The color hover, focus and press mix into the current link item's container: the label's color.

The glyph of the overflow item (more_horiz), the one entry that is a glyph and not a word, and the new-context mark after a link item's label: each takes the color a title's label has, so that it reads as part of the row of words.
The color hover, focus and press mix into the title's container: the label's color.

enter-duration.$description: How long the scrim takes to fade in as a modal surface opens. Each modal overlay's own enter duration aliases this one, so that its surface arrives with its scrim.

enter-easing.$description: The curve of the scrim's fade in; each modal overlay's own enter easing aliases it.

exit-duration.$description: How long the scrim takes to fade out as a modal surface closes. Each modal overlay's own exit duration aliases this one, so that its surface leaves with its scrim.

exit-easing.$description: The curve of the scrim's fade out; each modal overlay's own exit easing aliases it.

blur.$description: How much the scrim blurs what lies behind it: the radius of a Gaussian blur, with the meaning of CSS's blur() (the standard deviation). 0 dims without blurring. A platform that cannot blur what is behind a window draws the color alone. Each modal overlay's own scrim blur aliases this one.

color.$description: The dim over everything behind a modal surface, alpha included (the scrim role is the overlay as drawn). Each modal overlay's own scrim color aliases this one.

height.$description: The bar's minimum height, not counting the system inset below it.

padding.$description: How far the destinations' item containers are held in from the bar's top, bottom, start and end edges. The cells share the bar's width less this at each end, and an item container is as tall as the bar less this above and below; it is also the room the focus indicator has around a destination.

color.$description: The filled active indicator: the selected destination's share of the bar, in the strong color.
The selected icon, inverted on the filled active indicator.
The selected label, inverted on the filled active indicator.
The selected icon outside the filled active indicator, seen while it is on its way.
The selected label outside the filled active indicator, seen while it is on its way.
The color hover, focus and press mix into the filled indicator: the content drawn on it.
A destination of a filled bar that is not selected: as a tonal bar's.
The icon of a destination that is not selected where the filled active indicator covers it on its way across.
The label of a destination that is not selected where the filled active indicator covers it on its way across.

height.$description: Kept for the platforms that still draw a pill at least this high; the current spec makes the item container as tall as the bar less container.padding above and below and reads no height. Dropped once the last platform catches up.

padding-block.$description: The least space between the item container's top edge and the icon indicator, and between the label (the icon indicator, when no label is drawn) and its bottom edge. The bar grows in height to keep it.

padding-inline.$description: Inside the item container, on each side of the label: a label longer than the item container less this on each side is truncated.

shape.$description: The radius of the item container's four corners, at most half its height: full makes the destination's share of the bar a capsule.

width.$description: Kept for the platforms that still draw a pill around the icon and label at least this wide; the current spec makes the item container as wide as the destination's cell and reads no width. Dropped once the last platform catches up.

gap.$description: From the icon indicator to the label below it, inside the item container.

height.$description: The icon indicator's height; the label sits item.gap below it.

shape.$description: The radius of the icon indicator's four corners, at most half its height.

width.$description: The icon indicator's width. It is laid out in every system, transparent or not; in the default system it is the icon's own box.

size.$description: The icon of every destination.

feedback-duration.$description: How long the answer to a press takes to spread when sys.behavior.pressed-feedback is ripple (as Button's).

selection-duration.$description: How long the active indicator takes to slide to the newly selected destination, or to settle or return when a drag of it is released (the covered icon and label follow it over the same time), the icon indicator to grow in and the previous one to fade out, and labels to appear and disappear.

state-duration.$description: How long a state change takes, and how long the active indicator takes to come to the pointer when a drag is taken away from where it rests.

color.$description: The bar's top edge.
The tonal active indicator: the selected destination's share of the bar.
The selected icon where the active indicator covers it: all of it once the indicator has landed.
The selected label where the active indicator covers it: all of it once the indicator has landed.
The selected icon outside the active indicator: seen while the indicator is still on its way, and wherever a layer's indicator does not cover it.
The selected label outside the active indicator: seen while the indicator is still on its way, and wherever a layer's indicator does not cover it.
The icon of a destination that is not selected where the active indicator covers it, as the indicator slides across it to another destination.
The label of a destination that is not selected where the active indicator covers it on its way across.

collapsed.$description: The window width from which a responsive, collapsible drawer keeps its column beside the content (the column presentation). Below it nothing of the drawer is in the layout.

expanded.$description: The window width from which a responsive drawer is beside the content (the standard presentation). Below it the drawer is its column, or over the content.

color.$description: Kept for the platforms that still draw a destination's trailing string as a badge.
The active indicator of a collapsed drawer: the selected row with its label gone, in the expanded row's color.
The short label on the collapsed active indicator, where collapsedLabels draws one.
Seen only while the drawer collapses.
Seen only while the drawer collapses.
Kept for the platforms that still draw a destination's trailing string as a badge.
A collapsed destination that is not selected: as an expanded one's.
The short label under the icon, where collapsedLabels draws one.
Seen only while the drawer collapses.
Seen only while the drawer collapses: the trailing text fades out with the expanded label.

width.$description: The collapsed drawer's width, not counting the system inset at its start: the icon column. Every icon's center is half of it from the start edge, in both forms. In the default system it is container.padding-inline, item.padding-inline and the icon, mirrored: 12 + 12 + 24 + 12 + 12, so that a collapsed row is the expanded one cut after its icon's padding.

padding-block.$description: Inside the collapsed item container, above the icon indicator and below it (below the short label where one is drawn). In the default system it equals item.padding-inline, so the icon has the same space on every side and the collapsed cell is as high as the expanded row.

padding-inline.$description: Inside the collapsed item container, on each side of a short label, which is truncated inside it. Read only where collapsedLabels draws a label.

shape.$description: The collapsed item container's corners, at most half its height. The expanded row's own corners: collapsing a drawer removes its labels and changes no shape.

width.$description: The collapsed item container's width, centered in the icon column: the box around the icon, which carries hover, focus and press and is the active indicator while the destination is selected. In the default system it is the icon with item.padding-inline on each side, a square as high as the row.

gap.$description: From the icon indicator to the short label below it, where collapsedLabels draws one.

typescale.$description: The short label under the icon, on one line, where collapsedLabels draws one.

gap.$description: Between two cells (a destination's or a group's), so that a selected row and a hovered neighbour stay two shapes. Each cell's hit area reaches half of it above and below.

padding-block.$description: Above the header (or the first cell) and below the last cell, in both forms.

padding-inline.$description: From the drawer's edges to its item containers, headings, dividers and header, in both forms. Kept small, so that a row's fill and the area that answers hover reach nearly the drawer's whole width.

width.$description: The expanded drawer's width, not counting the system inset at its start. With the default padding a row is 216 wide: room for an icon, a name of some twenty characters and a short count.

color.$description: The color the header slot gives what it holds, inherited as its text style is: the content color of the drawer's surface.

gap.$description: From the header (its buttons, its slot and the main action) to the first cell.

item-gap.$description: Between two rows of the header: two header buttons, or a header button and the main action.

typescale.$description: The text style the header slot gives what it holds (NVD-38): the drawer's title, such as the product's name. It is inherited, so plain text placed in the slot is drawn in it, and an element of the product's that sets its own style keeps it.

height.$description: A section heading's minimum height; its text is centered in it. The row keeps this height while the drawer is collapsed, so the cells below it do not move.

typescale.$description: A section heading.

Kept for the platforms that still draw a destination's trailing string as a badge, which draw it with this; the current spec reads item.trailing-text.typescale. Dropped once the last platform catches up.

height.$description: The expanded item container's least height: the destination's row, which is also its active indicator and carries hover, focus and press. A menu item's height, so that a list of places and a list of commands are rows of one size; with the default icon it leaves item.padding-inline above and below the glyph.

shape.$description: The row's corners, in both forms: a menu item's. A row that is one choice among many keeps its step of the scale and is never a capsule.

gap.$description: Between the icon, the label and the trailing content of an expanded row.

height.$description: The icon indicator's height; while collapsed, the short label sits collapsed.item.gap below it.

shape.$description: The radius of the icon indicator's four corners, at most half its height.

width.$description: The icon indicator's width, centered on the icon. It is laid out in every system, transparent or not; in the default system it is the icon's own box.

nest-indent.$description: How much further toward the end a nested destination's content (its icon and label) starts, per level of nesting. Its item container, with its fill, state layer and focus indicator, keeps the full width of a top-level row. With the default icon and gap, a nested destination's label starts under its group's label.

padding-inline.$description: Inside the row: before the label of a destination without an icon, and after the trailing content; a menu item's. In the default system it is also the space an icon has on its start side, because the icon column is placed by it (collapsed.container.width).

size.$description: A glyph at the row's end: the trailing slot's glyph, and a group's chevron.

typescale.$description: The trailing count or short word: a regular weight, one step quieter than the medium-weight label.

disclosure-duration.$description: How long a group takes to open or close: its destinations revealed or hidden, the rows below moving, and its chevron turning.

enter-duration.$description: How long a drawer takes to slide in (and its scrim to fade in), or a standard drawer to open in the layout: the modal layer's, so that every modal surface of a product keeps one tempo.

exit-duration.$description: How long a drawer takes to slide out (and its scrim to fade out), or a standard drawer to close in the layout: the modal layer's.

expand-duration.$description: How long the drawer takes to widen from the icon column to its full width, or to narrow back, with every part that changes on the way (the edge, the labels, the active indicator, the header).

feedback-duration.$description: How long the answer to a press takes to spread when sys.behavior.pressed-feedback is ripple (as Button's).

selection-duration.$description: How long an icon indicator takes to grow in (and the previous one to fade out), and short labels to appear and disappear, when the selection changes. The item container does not use it: it changes color in place over state-duration.

state-duration.$description: How long a state change takes, and how long the item containers take to change color when the selection changes.

blur.$description: How much the scrim behind a modal drawer blurs what lies behind it: the modal layer's (0, none, in the default system).

color.$description: Dims the content behind a modal drawer: the modal layer's scrim, unless a system sets the drawer apart.
Kept for the platforms that still draw a destination's trailing string as a badge.
The active indicator: the selected row, in both forms.
On the active indicator the trailing text takes the indicator's content color; its regular weight keeps it quieter than the label.
Kept for the platforms that still draw a destination's trailing string as a badge.

gap.$description: Between two destinations.

padding-block.$description: Above the header (or the first destination) and below the last destination.

width.$description: The rail's width, not counting the system inset at its start.

gap.$description: From the header slot to the first destination.

width.$description: The item container: the active indicator's box behind the icon, which also carries hover, focus and press.

gap.$description: From the item container to the label below it.

size.$description: The icon of every destination.

feedback-duration.$description: How long the answer to a press takes to spread when sys.behavior.pressed-feedback is ripple (as Button's).

selection-duration.$description: How long the active indicator takes to grow in (and the previous one to fade out), and labels to move, when the selection changes.

color.$description: The rail's end edge.

repeat-delay.$description: How long a stepper is held before it begins to repeat its step. A waiting time, not a motion: kept where motion is reduced.

repeat-interval.$description: The time between two steps of a held stepper, for its first ten repeated steps.

repeat-interval-fast.$description: The time between two steps of a held stepper after its first ten repeated steps: the hold speeds up once, it does not change the size of a step.

gap.$description: Between the two steppers. 0 in the default system: they stand as close as their targets allow, each keeping sys.target.touch along the row, so two 40 buttons stand 8 apart and two that are 48 or wider touch.

inset.$description: From the container's end edge to the stepper nearest it: with a 40 button in a 48 container, the same room at the end as above and below.

width.$description: Width of the caret an empty active cell draws (OTC-7).

gap.$description: Distance between two cells, between a cell and the group mark, and between two rows of a wrapped code.

height.$description: Minimum height of a cell (48): the text field’s medium height and the touch target, so that a code input and a text field in one form are equally tall.

padding-inline.$description: The least room between a cell’s edge and its character on each side: what a cell keeps when it becomes narrow.

shape.$description: The corners of a cell: the text field’s.

width.$description: The widest a cell is drawn (40 in the default system). Cells share the row and become narrower than this where the row has less room (OTC-23).

typescale.$description: A character in a cell: the text field’s input style, drawn with tabular figures. 16 px in the default system, below which a touch browser zooms the page into a focused input.

state-duration.$description: How long a change of a cell’s colors and line takes when the state, the active cell, error or disabled changes: the text field’s state duration.

width.$description: Width of the line inside a cell’s edge at rest, where it is drawn at all: the error line. The focused width is the focused state’s token.

thickness.$description: Thickness of the group mark. A system that wants a wider gap and no mark sets this to nothing.

width.$description: Length of the mark drawn between two groups of cells.

color.$description: The caret in an empty active cell.
The fill of a cell, empty or filled: the stacked text field’s container.
The characters keep their color in error: the code is still what the person typed.
The line inside every cell’s edge while the field is in error, so that the field itself is marked and not only its text.
A character, and the mark that stands for it while mask is true.
The mark between two groups: quieter than the characters it stands between, as a prefix is beside a value.

gap.$description: The space above the actions while they stand below the text.

item-gap.$description: Between two actions along their row, and between rows where they wrap.

gap.$description: The space below what stands above the title — Breadcrumbs, or a Link back — before the eyebrow or the title.

The distance between the text (eyebrow, title, description, meta) and the actions while the actions stand beside it. Larger than any space inside the text, so the actions read as belonging to the whole head and not to one line of it.

color.$description: The description: secondary content, so that the title stays the first thing read. Held to 4.5:1 on every surface by the token invariants.

measure.$description: The description's longest line, as a multiple of its own font size (ems): the number prose limits its text blocks to, so a description and the paragraph under it end at the same edge when they are set at the same size. The title is not limited by it.

color.$description: The line under the head, where the product asks for it: the system's one hairline color. Decorative.

thickness.$description: The width of the line under the head.

color.$description: The eyebrow: secondary content, quieter than the title it stands above.

gap.$description: Between the eyebrow and the title. Small, so the two read as one head.

typescale.$description: The eyebrow's text style: the system's kicker, small and tracked wide. The page header draws it in capitals where the script has them (PGH-6); the token stores no text transform.

color.$description: The text of the meta line, where an item brings no color of its own (a Tag, a Link and an Avatar keep theirs).

gap.$description: The space above the meta line, below the description or, without one, the title.
Between a glyph or an avatar and the text of the same item: an author's picture and name, a calendar glyph and a date.

item-gap.$description: Between two items on one row of the meta line. The separator is drawn in the middle of it.

row-gap.$description: Between two rows of the meta line where it wraps. Small, so that a wrapped line still reads as one line of facts.

color.$description: The dot between two items: the color of the text it parts.

size.$description: The diameter of the dot drawn between two items on one row. Decorative: it is never at the start or the end of a row and is not exposed. A system that parts its meta items by space alone sets it to the scale's zero.

typescale.$description: The text of the meta line: secondary text, one step under the interface's running text, at every size.

color.$description: The title: the content color of the surface a page is drawn on.

container-width.$description: The width of the head itself — not of the window — from which it is wide: actions stand beside the title (PGH-10), and a large head draws its title at its own size (PGH-12). Below it the head is one column. It grows with enlarged text, so a head whose text was doubled goes to one column at twice this width.

gap.$description: Space between the arrow and the text beside it.

min-width.$description: The least width an item has beside the other one. Where the layout gives the pagination less than two of these and the gap, the items stack.

padding.$description: Space between an item's edge and its content, on every side.

shape.$description: The corners of an item, and of its focus ring. The value an outlined card has, because an item is drawn as one.

gap.$description: Space between the previous and the next item, side by side or stacked.

size.$description: The arrow's box.

color.$description: An item's fill. None at rest: it is where hover, focus and press are drawn.
The arrow.
The direction word: secondary text.
An item's edge: the one hairline.
The color hover, focus and press mix into the container: the title's.
The destination's title: the text's own color. An item is pressed as a whole and marked by its edge and its arrow, so its title is not drawn as a text link.

gap.$description: Space between the direction word and the title under it.

typescale.$description: The direction word (Previous, Next) above the title.

feedback-duration.$description: How long the answer to a press takes to spread when sys.behavior.pressed-feedback is ripple: the pressed layer grows from the point of contact over this time, with state-easing. Unused by the other choices.

width.$description: The thickness of an item's edge.

typescale.$description: The destination's title.

arrangement.$description: How the actions sit. fill: a full-width Button group, the actions sharing the container's inner width equally. end: at their own widths, aligned to the end. Either stacks into a column when the row does not fit (POP-15). The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values; platforms receive the name.

gap.$description: Between two actions, in a row or stacked. At sys.target.touch minus the lowest Button (small, 32) or more, every action keeps its whole target in a column, as comp.dialog.actions.gap and comp.side-sheet.actions.gap do.

margin-block-start.$description: Between the content (or the header, where there is no content) and the actions.

variant.$description: The Button variant the popover gives an action whose variant the product did not set (POP-16). An action whose variant is set keeps it. The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values, the core Button variants; platforms receive the name.

height.$description: From the container's edge to the arrow's tip. The container stands this much farther from the anchor while an arrow is drawn, so the tip keeps the offset.

inset.$description: The least distance between the arrow's base and either end of the edge it stands on. Where the corner radius is larger, the radius is the least distance, so the arrow never stands on a curve.

visible.$description: Whether a popover whose arrow the product did not set draws one (POP-10). off: the container alone, as a menu. on: a triangle on the edge that faces the anchor. A popover whose arrow is set keeps what it was given. The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values; platforms receive the name.

width.$description: The arrow's base, along the container's edge. The tooltip's.

variant.$description: The Button variant of the close button, an icon-only small Button (POP-13). The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values, the core Button variants; platforms receive the name.

color.$description: The popover's sheet: the menu's, the docked picker's and the search view's color, so that every surface that opens from a control is the same sheet.

elevation.$description: The level of the menu's sheet: above the page and its raised parts, below a dialog.

gap.$description: Between the header and the content.

max-height.$description: The greatest height of a popover, whatever room the window has; taller content scrolls between the header and the actions. A popover that would need more is a dialog's or a sheet's content.

max-width.$description: The greatest width of a popover sized by its content; longer content wraps. Wider than a menu (a popover holds sentences and fields, a menu holds labels), narrower than a dialog.

min-width.$description: The least width of a popover sized by its content: the menu's, so that the popover and the menu one control could open are never narrower than each other.

padding-block.$description: From the container's top and bottom edges to its first and last part.

padding-inline.$description: From the container's start and end edges to the header, the content (while inset) and the actions.

color.$description: Handed to the content as the platform's inherited foreground.
The one hairline, below the header and above the actions while the content scrolls.

gap.$description: Between the headline and the close button.

typescale.$description: The smallest heading: a popover's headline labels a small surface. The rich tooltip's title has the same style; a dialog's headline is one step larger.

close-duration.$description: How long the container takes to fade out. The menu's.

open-duration.$description: How long the container takes to fade in and grow from the anchor's side. The menu's.

offset.$description: The gap between the anchor's edge and the nearest part of the popover, on the side the popover is placed: the container's edge, or the arrow's tip while an arrow is drawn. A popover whose offset prop is set uses that in its place. The menu's and the tooltip's distance.

window-margin.$description: The least distance between the popover and the edges of the window's safe area and the on-screen keyboard; the popover flips, shifts, narrows or, in a window smaller than itself, covers its anchor to keep it.

cycle-duration.$description: One cycle of the indeterminate animation (the bar's segment crossing the track once, the ring's arc turning once), and one pulse of its reduced-motion form.

cycle-easing.$description: How the bar's indeterminate segment and the reduced-motion pulse move through a cycle. The ring always turns at constant speed.

size.$description: The diameter of the dot a determinate bar draws at the track's end, in the indicator color, to mark where the track ends, under either separation; never drawn larger than the bar is thick, and not drawn while the indicator covers it at max. 0 draws none.

gap.$description: Under gap: empty space, measured along the track, between the end of a determinate indicator and the rest of the track. Not drawn under divider.

separation.$description: How a determinate indicator is told from the rest of its track. divider: the indicator is drawn on the track with no space between them; the edge where its color ends is the line. gap: track.gap of empty space is left between them. Whether a bar draws the stop indicator is stop-indicator.size, not this. Follows the system's choice; an instance's separation prop overrides it (PRG-17). The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values; platforms receive the name.

shape.$description: The corner radius of the bar's ends and of the indicator's ends, clamped to half the thickness. The ring's caps are round unless this is sys.shape.corner.none.

gap.$description: Space between the end of a heading's text and its anchor link.
Space between two blocks that follow each other: paragraphs, lists, quotes, and any component placed in the flow.

after.$description: Space between a level 1 heading and the block that follows it — also when that block is another heading. Never larger than block.gap.

before.$description: Space above a level 1 heading, when something precedes it in the same flow. Larger than block.gap, so the heading belongs to what follows it.

after.$description: Space between a level 2 heading and the block that follows it — also when that block is another heading. Never larger than block.gap.

before.$description: Space above a level 2 heading, when something precedes it in the same flow. Larger than block.gap, so the heading belongs to what follows it.

after.$description: Space between a level 3 heading and the block that follows it — also when that block is another heading. Never larger than block.gap.

before.$description: Space above a level 3 heading, when something precedes it in the same flow. Larger than block.gap, so the heading belongs to what follows it.

after.$description: Space between a level 4 heading and the block that follows it — also when that block is another heading. Never larger than block.gap.

before.$description: Space above a level 4 heading, when something precedes it in the same flow. Larger than block.gap, so the heading belongs to what follows it.

after.$description: Space between a level 5 heading and the block that follows it — also when that block is another heading. Never larger than block.gap.

before.$description: Space above a level 5 heading, when something precedes it in the same flow. Larger than block.gap, so the heading belongs to what follows it.

after.$description: Space between a level 6 heading and the block that follows it — also when that block is another heading. Never larger than block.gap.

before.$description: Space above a level 6 heading, when something precedes it in the same flow. Larger than block.gap, so the heading belongs to what follows it.

gap.$description: Space between the items of a list, between an item's text and a list nested in it, and between a term and its description.

line-height.$description: The line height of running text whose language is Japanese, as a multiple of the running text's size (PRS-31): the space between two lines is 0.85 of a character, near the whole character that the Japanese layout requirements (W3C JLREQ) recommend for lines longer than 35 characters, as the measure's 36 are. Latin text keeps the running text style's own line height.

typescale.$description: A lead paragraph: the one paragraph, marked by the author, that introduces the text. The same at both sizes: at large the running text already is this role, and the lead is then told apart by nothing (no larger body role exists in the core).

indent.$description: How far a list's items are set in from the list's start edge, at every depth; the marker hangs in this space. Also the inset of a description. Wide enough for a two-digit number and its period at both sizes.

measure.$description: The longest line of a text block, as a multiple of the running text's font size (ems): 36 full-width characters of Japanese or Chinese, about 72 to 80 of Latin text. A text block is never wider; a block that is not text (a table, a code block, a figure) is not limited by it.

gap.$description: Space between blocks inside a list item or a quote, between the items of a list whose items hold more than one block, and between the groups of a description list. Smaller than block.gap, so what is nested reads as one unit.

inset.$description: Space between the line and the quote's content.

color.$description: The line along a quote's start edge: the system's one hairline color. Decorative: the quote is exposed as a quote without it.

thickness.$description: The line's width. Heavier than a hairline, so it reads as a mark and not as a container's edge.

gap.$description: Space above and below a rule (a thematic break). The rule itself is the divider, drawn from the divider's tokens.

size.$description: The mark of a task item (done or not done), drawn in place of the list marker from the system's icon set.
The round state layer behind the ring, 40; the 48 target reaches 4 beyond it on each side.

color.$description: The fill inside the selected ring in error, drawn at fill.opacity: the ring's color, as out of error.
The label keeps naming the option in error: the error is the set's, and its words are below the set.
The ring of a selected option in error: the error role, as an error checkbox's box. The stroke is as heavy as out of error, so the selection is still told by weight.
The fill while unselected and in error: none in the default system, as out of error.
The label keeps naming the option in error: the error is the set's, and its words are below the set.
The ring of an unselected option in error: the error role, as an error checkbox's outline. At least 3:1 on every surface (the build holds the role to 4.5:1).

inset.$description: How far the fill's edge sits inside the ring's inner edge, wherever the stroke is at that moment. 0 fills the whole disc left inside the ring; a larger inset leaves a gap between ring and fill and turns the fill into a dot.

opacity.$description: The opacity the fill is drawn at, applied to the fill color of the condition and state. The fill lies inside the ring, never under it, so a translucent ring (disabled) never shows the fill through it. Where the fill meets the ring (fill.inset 0), the fill as drawn is held 3:1 against the ring in every enabled state, on every surface role (WCAG 1.4.11).
